title: 72-year-old's restaurant was struggling; then a stranger's video changed everything
summary_full: A viral Instagram video by content creator Robert Schrott brought unexpected support to Greek's Grill, a struggling family restaurant in Chandler, Arizona. Owner Fred Najour, 72, saw customers line up within days, while a fundraiser started by Schrott raised more than $19,000.
